exposure: number of providers trained in Emergency Obstetric Care (EmOC)
cohort: Births at 149 first referral units (FRUs) in Bihar, India
finding: The study found a low caesarean delivery rate (3.1%) across Bihar's first referral units, highlighting that the presence of a functioning operating room, obstetrician-gynecologists, and EmOC-trained providers were strongly associated with higher CD rates.
